component.name: SettingsItemRenderer
component.script:
sub init() m.labelField = m.top.findNode("labelField") m.valueField = m.top.findNode("valueField") ' m.top.observeField is no longer needed since we used onChange in the interface end sub
sub onContentChanged() content = m.top.itemContent if content = invalid then return
m.labelField.text = content.title
if content.description <> invalid and content.description <> "" m.valueField.text = content.description else m.valueField.text = "(not set)" end if end sub
